name: Sparse daily county-level stratified outcome counts
description: Sparse daily, county-level hospitalization counts for heatwave-associated outcomes among Medicare Fee-for-Service (FFS) beneficiaries with 12 months of continuous coverage (i.e., not enrolled in any HMO), stratified by age group, race, sex, and dual eligibility. The outcomes are defined by groups of International Classification of Diseases (ICD) principal discharge diagnosis codes identified using the Clinical Classifications Software (CCS) algorithm.

content.dual: Int32: Dual eligibility for Medicare and Medicaid. 1 = Dual eligible for both Medicare and Medicaid, 0 = Not dual eligible
content.uti: Int32: Count of hospitalizations for urinary tract infection (CCS 159)
content.septicemia: Int32: Count of hospitalizations for septicemia (CCS 2)
content.diabetes: Int32: Count of hospitalizations for diabetes mellitus with complications (CCS 50)
content.acute_renal_failure: Int32: Count of hospitalizations for acute renal failure (CCS 157)
content.fluid_electrolyte: Int32: Count of hospitalizations for fluid and electrolyte disorders (CCS 55)
content.other_injury: Int32: Count of hospitalizations for heat stroke and other external causes (CCS 244)
content.peripheral_athero: Int32: Count of hospitalizations for peripheral atherosclerosis (CCS 114)
